band.title: A square that bends
band.intro: At the crossroads of modern jazz, rock and progressive music, UNSQWARE shapes a distinctive instrumental world where electric textures meet organic grooves and soaring improvisations. Formed in Nantes in 2022, the quartet explores contrasts, plays with tension and dynamics, and builds music that is as immersive as it is unpredictable.
band.p1: Driven by solid musical experience and a shared urge to push boundaries, the band has developed a sound that is powerful, subtle and cinematic all at once. In the vein of Aaron Parks, Snarky Puppy and The Cinematic Orchestra, UNSQWARE moves between finely crafted compositions, incisive rhythms and free-flowing passages. Each piece opens a new space for exploration, where writing and improvisation intertwine to make room for the unexpected.
band.p2: The project began when Florian Roy (bass, double bass) and Charles Demay (drums) came together around a shared wish: to create original music rooted in an open, borderless contemporary jazz. Fabien Maurin (guitar), trained at CIM in Paris, then broadened the band's sound with a new melodic dimension and wider arranging possibilities. Victor Pavel (piano, keys) finally completed the quartet, giving this musical identity its full scope.

music.title: Totem Live Session
music.totemText: In this live session released in 2025, the band's aesthetic comes into focus as it leans further into its rock and progressive side. The project builds a strong visual concept around its name: a square that bends, transforms and escapes its own geometry. A metaphor for its music, which likes to step outside the frame and blur the lines.
music.totemPlace: Recorded at La Maison du Son, Port-Saint-Père — September 2025
music.epText: Recorded with Franck Martin in Rennes (Ezurlie Magic Studio, producer of Namas).
music.evoliText: A balance between the rigour of jazz and the raw power of a rock aesthetic. Available on all platforms.
